observations: CodeGraph.init creates the in-project .codegraph directory and database; createDirectory also writes .codegraph/.gitignore. These are within proposed declared tool state only if the bound workspace and pre-existing state are trusted.

The CLI init path performs initial indexAll, then can offer ignored nested-repository configuration that writes project-root codegraph.json on an empty graph, and can offer a watcher fallback that installs Git sync hooks. Neither optional source/config/hook write is covered by the user's tool-state authority.

The CLI serve --mcp -p <path> --no-watch path disables file watching through CODEGRAPH_NO_WATCH, but native MCP startup and query/write footprint still require a controlled owned-fixture qualification. No process was launched for this inspection.

The package exports a programmatic SDK CodeGraph.init/open that bypasses the CLI's optional prompts, but its Node launcher/runtime and full write footprint have not been qualified for Vulgata's direct host.
planning_consequence: Select and qualify one exact preparation/startup route on an explicitly owned fixture before any dedicated managed workspace use. If the chosen route cannot keep all writes within declared contained tool state, report the exact behavior and return for authority review; do not silently expand permission.
